1: // Minimal endless‑runner based on IDEA.md
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if(!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 300;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 150;
8: 
9:   // lanes (three equally spaced)
10:   const laneCount = 3;
11:   const laneWidth = W / laneCount;
12:   const playerSize = 20;
13:   let playerLane = 1; // 0:left,1:center,2:right
14:   const playerY = H - playerSize - 10;
15: 
16:   // blocks
17:   const blocks = [];
18:   const blockSize = 20;
19:   const blockSpeed = 2; // pixels per frame
20:   const spawnInterval = 800; // ms
21:   let lastSpawn = 0;
22: 
23:   let startTime = null;
24:   const maxTime = 120000; // 2 minutes
25:   let score = 0;
26:   let running = true;
27: 
28:   function spawnBlock(){
29:     const lane = Math.floor(Math.random()*laneCount);
30:     blocks.push({lane, y: -blockSize});
31:   }
32: 
33:   function update(dt){
34:     if(!running) return;
35:     const now = performance.now();
36:     if(!startTime) startTime = now;
37:     const elapsed = now - startTime;
38:     if(elapsed >= maxTime){ running = false; alert('Time up! Score: '+Math.floor(score)); return; }
39:     // spawn
40:     if(now - lastSpawn > spawnInterval){
41:       spawnBlock();
42:       lastSpawn = now;
43:     }
44:     // move blocks
45:     for(let i=blocks.length-1;i>=0;i--){
46:       const b = blocks[i];
47:       b.y += blockSpeed;
48:       // collision
49:       const px = laneWidth*playerLane + laneWidth/2 - playerSize/2;
50:       const py = playerY;
51:       if(b.lane===playerLane && b.y+blockSize>py && b.y<py+playerSize){
52:         running = false;
53:         alert('Game Over! Score: '+Math.floor(score));
54:         return;
55:       }
56:       // remove off‑screen
57:       if(b.y>H) blocks.splice(i,1);
58:     }
59:     // score based on distance (time)
60:     score = elapsed/10; // arbitrary scaling
61:   }
62: 
63:   function draw(){
64:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
65:     // draw grid lines
66:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.2)';

68:       ctx.beginPath();

71:       ctx.stroke();

74:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
75:     const px = laneWidth*playerLane + laneWidth/2 - playerSize/2;

79:     blocks.forEach(b=>{

81:       ctx.fillRect(x, b.y, blockSize, blockSize);
82:     });

84:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
85:     ctx.font = '14px monospace';
86:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+Math.floor(score),10,20);
87:   }
88:
